governing_statement: The Endpoint-B enumerated cluster sign-flip p-value is exact conditional on the frozen assumption that cluster-level paired treated-minus-control contributions are sign-symmetric/exchangeable around zero under the null.

what_the_p_value_is.procedure: exact enumerated cluster sign-flip test over all 2^G sign vectors of the G cluster means
what_the_p_value_is.null_tested: sharp null that the mean cluster-level paired contribution is zero
what_the_p_value_is.exact_with_respect_to: the enumeration over sign vectors, given the sign-symmetry assumption

what_the_p_value_is_NOT.why: Treatment here is which hypotheses an LLM proposed. It was never randomly assigned to clusters, so the reference distribution is not generated by a known randomization mechanism. The sign-flip reference distribution is imposed by assumption, not by design.

assumption_dependence.assumption: under the null, each cluster's paired treated-minus-control contribution is distributed symmetrically about zero and clusters are exchangeable
threats: clusters are competitions/periods, not randomized units, so cross-cluster dependence or systematic asymmetry would invalidate symmetry
G is small (~8), so the enumeration has coarse granularity and minimum attainable p is bounded below by 2^-G-scale resolution
a single dominant cluster can drive the statistic; per-cluster contributions must be read alongside the aggregate

pre_committed_degradation_rule.rationale: The p-value is the assumption-dependent part. The point estimate and the stability evidence do not depend on the sign-symmetry assumption and remain the durable scientific content.
